title: Info for Volunteers - Boston Marathon (BAA)
claims: Volunteer assignments are grouped into Pre-Race, Hopkinton, Boston, Medical and Amateur Radio categories.

The along-the-course team has about 100 volunteers stationed with medical tents and hydration stations; the transportation team has about 40, the finish team about 60, the start team about 40, and net control about 30 plus about 20 finish-area radio volunteers.
Volunteer roles include expo merchandise sales and bib distribution, athlete's village greeters and corral monitors, gear check, finish-area food distribution, marshals and amateur radio net control.
